title: Research: PR #2308's P112 shared correction needs at least 12 COPY units
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #2308 proves a shared rational correction basis and leaves its complete
physical charge open. This focused audit of its named P112 frame pair finds
that a complete additive scalar correction requires **at least 12 COPY rank
units**, while its stated fixed-profile 5% screen allows **at most 8**.

The package preserves the predecessor's exact rational sharing result. It
supplies a source-bound scalar endpoint/cost audit and a written rank-to-cost
proof, with exact finite certificates:

- The named frames overlap in four ports, so their union has 12 ports.
- The displayed common basis has coefficient parity rank 1, but the ordinary
  separate-term support COPY ranks are `[1,1,4,4,1,1,4,4]` per direction,
  **40 total**. Rescaling the coefficients by 2 and the basis by 1/2 reduces
  parity rank to zero without changing the scalar map or support bill.
- The two cross-block corrections leave 32 forbidden within-union entries.
  One explicit input gives target value `23/2` instead of `11`.
- The forced `12 x 64` correction rectangle has rank 12. Its integer-scaled
  minor has determinant 2048, giving a COPY floor for **any number of arbitrary
  complex additive scalar factors with the original G/2 map retained**.
- Correctly binding unpaid coordinates to `31/28`, the exact favorable moment
  at the predecessor's 5% target is greater than 1.00042899363319 at that floor.
  Merely correcting the port count, while still assuming +8, does pass; the
  lower-bound argument is essential.

The natural deleted-frame base decoder itself grows from COPY64 to COPY68 on
these ports. Its displayed cross-block realization therefore costs 108 before
the missing repair. This is a finite algebraic invoice, not a native program
or an optimum over other bases.

Only `research/p112-shared-correction-cost-audit/` is added. No source archive,
predecessor package, selected record, compiler or frontier is changed. This
does not rule out a redesigned whole decoder, bundled operator interface or
changed local profile, and claims no supplier or new kappa.

- **Artifact/reproduction:** package README, TASK, sources, certificate, receipt

## Validation

On CPython 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/p112-shared-correction-cost-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p112-shared-correction-cost-audit/check_certificate.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-shared-correction-cost-audit --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-shared-correction-cost-audit
```

All pass. The primary line is:

```text
PASS_P112_SHARED_CORRECTION_COST_AUDIT union=12 parity_rank=1 correction_COPY=40 forbidden_entries=32 additive_COPY_floor=12 five_percent_screen=FAIL controls=10 no_new_kappa
```

The ten semantic control groups include omitted/changed factors, wrong label
map, coefficient-gauge invariance, wrong line-only mask, duplicate-port count,
the dirty counterexample, all 224 scalar columns, a valid repaired fitting
matrix and a dependent minor. The second checker uses explicit binary spans
and independently reconstructed integer minors modulo101, without importing
the primary checker. A nonzero integer minor modulo101 certifies its
nonvanishing over Q/C; it is not a finite-field replacement for an identity.

A Git-free source export passes both checkers and remains byte-identical after
default replay. Additional controls reject a false lower-bound receipt,
changed source bytes and an occupied output path, preserving the occupied
file. The research baseline bindings, prescribed local-ceiling positive control,
package metadata/pins and whitespace check also pass.

Not checked: the predecessor's 20,160-block census, another pair, the optimum
additive bill, a whole redesigned decoder or physical sharing interface,
native phases/chronology, dirty helper restoration, global owners/idle profile,
precision, all-size admission, hosted CI or the selected cold replay. The
five-percent exclusion retains the predecessor's fixed local profile; a
changed profile needs a new complete screen.

The registered replay (primary audit and second check) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about a second and left the worktree unchanged. The basic counts check by hand: two eight-port frames sharing four ports have a 12-port union, and a rank-12 correction rectangle needs at least 12 rank-one scalar terms, each costing at least one COPY unit.

## Open next questions

The package records two bounded follow-ups: solve the full mixed-port scalar
fitting problem while redesigning the whole decoder; or specify a block/operator
interface that implements the sharing with a complete dirty-input identity and
tariff. Start from the forced rectangle or the `(16,20)` counterexample, then
test a favorable completed budget. Neither is supplied by coefficient parity.
